messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — consolidating action items for the observability/analytics correctness issues (missing spans, bad aggregation, ETL lag). Posting owners + rough timelines, please ack or update inline.

elaine: Actions: 
- A1: tracing span dropout (svc-x -> tracer pipeline) -> owner @ajay -> ETA 2025-05-09 -> ticket INF-4321
- A2: aggregation skew in metrics pipeline -> owner @maria -> ETA 2025-04-28 -> PR https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/analytics/pull/512
- A3: ETL backfill + alert tuning for delayed partitions -> owner @tim -> ETA 2025-05-15 -> ticket DATA-778
- A4: nightly regression check for span loss (cron job + alert) -> owner @lex -> ETA 2025-05-02 -> add to CI 

ajay: ack. putting INF-4321 into my sprint. initial root cause looks like a race in the sampler -> exporter handoff. will send debug logs by EOD.

maria: ack. aggregation fix is mostly done, running integration test with synthetic traffic now. expect PR review tomorrow.

tim: ack. I’ll set up the backfill job and a temporary higher-severity alert for lag > 30m. ETA label may slip if we need infra quota for workers.

lex: I can add the nightly check. question: do we want a lightweight golden-spans set or full trace replay? leaning golden set for now.

elaine: golden-set first, replay later if false positives persist. lex — can you own the schema for golden set?

lex: yes, will draft schema and share today.

ajay: debug logs: found 3 dropped batches between 2025-03-12 03:00Z and 03:20Z. snippet: 
```
ERROR exporter: timeout writing to kafka topic=traces.partitions partition=4 err=write timeout
```
Looks like transient broker saturation + retry backoff misconfig. I’ll add circuit-breaker and metrics for exporter queue size.

maria: FYI aggregation skew repro steps (from postmortem):
1) load with high cardinality keys > 100k
2) ingest window misaligned at shard boundary
3) mapreduce reduce stage dropped "null" keys
Working on test harness that simulates boundary conditions.

elaine: good. For tracking: I created a lightweight tracker doc and linked tickets. Also scheduling a 15m check-in every Mon/Wed until all items closed. Please add +1 for times that don't work.

ajay: times ok.

maria: can do Mon 10am PT, Wed 9am PT works.

tim: Wed 9am PT collides with infra sync, please Tue 11am PT instead?

elaine: changed to Tue 11am PT and Thu 9am PT then. sent calendar invites.

oncall-bot: Reminder: INC-2025-03-12-ETL-lag postmortem accepted. Action items must be updated in JIRA by owners within 72h.

elaine: quick note about recurring patterns — across the last 3 incidents we saw: 1) broker saturation, 2) shard-boundary aggregation edge cases, 3) missing alert coverage for partition lag. Adding a workstream to address each pattern so we stop papering over symptoms.

maria: agree. proposing a cross-team retro next sprint to formalize patterns + create pre-deploy checks.

lex: will add automated nightly smoke that verifies sample trace retention; if golden-set mismatches > 5% trigger alert.

ajay: planning change: exporter will track per-batch sequence IDs to help root-cause later. opens INF-4321-1 subtask.

tim: for ETL capacity I'll request short-term quota bump and run backfill in low-cost zone. opening DATA-778-1 subtask.

elaine: thanks all. next steps: owners update their tickets with ETA and test plan by EOD tomorrow. I’ll post a summary after that. :memo: :thumbsup:
